name: Gross Sales Revenue
description: Recorded order sales in USD, filtered by order date and conformed dimensions. Before recorded refunds; product selections apply to product measures instead.

name: COGS
description: Recorded cost of goods sold from orders, in USD. No refund-related COGS recovery is assumed.

name: Gross Profit
description: Recorded sales less recorded COGS. Gross profit before refunds, operating costs, tax, shipping costs and advertising expense; not net profit.

name: Gross Margin %
description: Gross profit divided by recorded sales; blank when sales are zero.

name: Total Orders
description: Number of orders at native order grain, by order date. Does not multiply with items or pageviews.

name: Average Order Value
description: Recorded sales divided by orders in the selected order-date period; before refunds.

name: Average Items Per Order
description: Recorded item count from orders divided by native order count.

name: Total Refund Amount
description: Recorded refund events in USD, selected by refund event date. This is cash-flow timing, not the original sale cohort.

name: Net Revenue After Recorded Refunds
description: Item sales on order dates less refund events on refund dates within the selected period. Both sides share sold-product scope. Item sales reconcile to order sales when no product is selected. This is period flow, not a restated sale cohort.

name: Gross Profit After Refunds (No Recovery)
description: Item-level gross profit less recorded refunds with matching product scope, assuming no COGS recovery. Reconciles to order-level gross profit less refunds without product filters. Excludes operating costs; not net profit.

name: Refund Amount %
description: Refund event dollars divided by same-period item sales dollars with matching product scope. Item sales reconcile to orders. Event dates differ from sale dates; can exceed 100% in a narrow refund-heavy period.

name: Refund Events
description: Count of recorded refund events by refund date; distinct from refunded items or refunded orders.

name: Refunded Orders (Event Date)
description: Orders with at least one refund event in the selected refund-date period.

name: Average Refund Lag Days
description: Mean calendar days from original order date to recorded refund event date for selected refund events.

name: Recorded Refunds On Selected Sales
description: All recorded refunds attached to items sold in the selected order-date period, observed through the refund-file cutoff. Recent sales have shorter follow-up.

name: Refunded Items (Sale Cohort)
description: Number of sold items with any recorded refund through the source cutoff, filtered by original sale date. Each item counts at most once.

name: Product Refund Rate
description: Refunded sold items divided by units sold in the original sale cohort. Right-censored at the refund cutoff; compare equally mature cohorts.

name: Sale Cohort Refund Amount %
expression: DIVIDE([Recorded Refunds On Selected Sales], [Product Revenue])
description: Recorded refund dollars on the selected sold-item cohort divided by that cohort’s item sales dollars. Not refund event-date cash flow.

name: Total Sessions
description: Count of distinct native session rows by session start date. One row per source website session.

name: Unique Website Visitors
description: Distinct observed website user IDs active in the selected session-date period. IDs are not verified people or identity-resolved customers.

name: New Visitor Sessions
expression: CALCULATE([Total Sessions], KEEPFILTERS('Dim_Visitor'[Visitor Type] = "New visitor session"))
description: Sessions with source is_repeat_session = 0. Source flag is preserved; no invented visitor identity logic.

name: Repeat Visitor Sessions
expression: CALCULATE([Total Sessions], KEEPFILTERS('Dim_Visitor'[Visitor Type] = "Repeat visitor session"))
description: Sessions with source is_repeat_session = 1; this does not imply a prior purchase.

name: Converted Sessions
description: Sessions with at least one linked recorded order, attributed to session start date. Multiple orders would still count once.

name: Session-to-Order Conversion Rate
description: Converted sessions / total sessions, with both numerator and denominator on session date. This is not a ratio of order-date orders to session-date sessions.

name: Campaign Orders
description: Linked recorded order count attributed to the acquiring session’s date, channel and campaign. May differ from order-date counts near midnight.

name: Campaign Revenue
description: Recorded linked order sales attributed to the acquiring session’s start date and tagging. Revenue is grouped to one session before enrichment.

name: Revenue Per Session
description: Session-attributed recorded sales / sessions in the same session-date context, in USD.

name: Traffic Source Contribution
description: Sessions for the current traffic selection divided by sessions across all channels; other conformed filters retained.

name: Revenue Per Tagged Marketing Session
expression:
VAR _revenue = CALCULATE([Campaign Revenue], KEEPFILTERS('Dim_Channel'[Traffic Group] IN {"Tagged search", "Tagged social"}))
VAR _sessions = CALCULATE([Total Sessions], KEEPFILTERS('Dim_Channel'[Traffic Group] IN {"Tagged search", "Tagged social"}))
RETURN DIVIDE(_revenue, _sessions)
description: Revenue per session restricted to observed tagged search/social traffic. Tagging is not proof of paid acquisition.

name: Desktop Conversion
description: Converted desktop sessions / desktop sessions on session date. Blank if an incompatible device filter is active.

name: Mobile Conversion
description: Converted mobile sessions / mobile sessions on session date. Blank if an incompatible device filter is active.

name: Bounced Sessions
description: Sessions with exactly one recorded pageview. This is a pageview-count bounce definition; engagement time is unavailable.

name: Landing Page Bounce Rate
description: Sessions with exactly one recorded pageview divided by all sessions, grouped by the earliest (timestamp, pageview ID) URL. No engagement threshold is available.

name: Total Pageviews
description: Total source pageviews from per-session aggregation, filtered by session start date rather than individual pageview dates.

name: Product Reach Sessions
description: Sessions with any observed product stage URL. Repeat views count once; this measure does not impose prior-stage ordering.

name: Product Page Reach Rate
description: Any-reach product sessions / all sessions. For ordered progression use the sequential funnel measures.

name: Cart Reach Sessions
description: Sessions with any observed cart stage URL. Repeat views count once; this measure does not impose prior-stage ordering.

name: Cart Reach Rate
description: Any-reach cart sessions / all sessions. For ordered progression use the sequential funnel measures.

name: Shipping Reach Sessions
description: Sessions with any observed shipping stage URL. Repeat views count once; this measure does not impose prior-stage ordering.

name: Shipping Reach Rate
description: Any-reach shipping sessions / all sessions. For ordered progression use the sequential funnel measures.

name: Billing Reach Sessions
description: Sessions with any observed billing stage URL. Repeat views count once; this measure does not impose prior-stage ordering.

name: Billing Reach Rate
description: Any-reach billing sessions / all sessions. For ordered progression use the sequential funnel measures.

name: Sequential Product Sessions
description: Sessions completing every stage through product in strict (timestamp, pageview ID) order. Purchase additionally requires a linked order at/after billing. Count once per session.

name: Sequential Cart Sessions
description: Sessions completing every stage through cart in strict (timestamp, pageview ID) order. Purchase additionally requires a linked order at/after billing. Count once per session.

name: Sequential Shipping Sessions
description: Sessions completing every stage through shipping in strict (timestamp, pageview ID) order. Purchase additionally requires a linked order at/after billing. Count once per session.

name: Sequential Billing Sessions
description: Sessions completing every stage through billing in strict (timestamp, pageview ID) order. Purchase additionally requires a linked order at/after billing. Count once per session.

name: Sequential Purchase Sessions
description: Sessions completing every stage through purchase in strict (timestamp, pageview ID) order. Purchase additionally requires a linked order at/after billing. Count once per session.

name: Checkout Reach Rate
description: Sessions reaching /shipping at any point divided by sessions. Shipping is the first observed checkout step.

name: Purchase Completion Rate
description: Strict sequential purchases divided by strict sequential billing sessions. Both use the session-start cohort.

name: Stage Sessions
description: Distinct sessions completing every stage up to the selected ordered stage. Blank for a total spanning multiple stages.

name: Previous Stage Sessions
expression:
VAR _stage = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_FunnelStage'[Stage Order])
RETURN SWITCH(_stage, 1, [Total Sessions], 2, [Total Sessions], 3, [Sequential Product Sessions], 4, [Sequential Cart Sessions], 5, [Sequential Shipping Sessions], 6, [Sequential Billing Sessions])
description: Distinct sessions at the preceding sequential stage; landing uses all sessions as its baseline.

name: Stage Conversion %
description: Current ordered stage sessions / previous stage sessions. Landing is 100% when sessions exist.

name: Stage Reach %
description: Current ordered stage sessions / all selected sessions.

name: Funnel Abandonment Sessions
description: Previous-stage sessions less current-stage sessions. These are observed stage drop-offs, not inferred causes.

name: Funnel Abandonment %
description: Drop-off sessions / preceding ordered-stage sessions; zero at landing.

name: Product Revenue
description: Recorded item sales by product and original order date. Additive across sold products; includes primary and cross-sell items.

name: Product COGS
description: Recorded item-level cost by product and original order date, before any assumed recovery.

name: Product Gross Profit
description: Item sales less item COGS; product-level estimated gross profit before refunds and operating costs.

name: Product Margin %
description: Product gross profit / recorded product revenue.

name: Units Sold
description: Native item row count. Source has no item-quantity column; each row is one sold item, reconciled to order item counts.

name: Product Revenue Contribution %
description: Current product revenue divided by revenue across all products, retaining date and acquisition filters.

name: Orders Containing Selected Product
description: Distinct orders containing selected sold items. Totals are distinct orders, not sum of product order counts.

name: Primary Item Revenue
description: Revenue from items with source is_primary_item = 1, by item product; not whole basket revenue.

name: Cross-Sell Revenue
description: Revenue from items with source is_primary_item = 0.

name: Cross-Sell Units
description: Sold item rows designated non-primary by the source.

name: Orders With Cross Sell
description: Orders with more than one recorded item. This is a basket-level count on order date.

name: Cross-Sell Attach Rate
description: Orders containing more than one item / orders. Does not imply a causal recommendation effect.

name: Paying Customers
description: Distinct observed user IDs placing an order in the selected order-date period; separate from all website visitors.

name: Repeat Purchasing Customers
description: Observed user IDs with at least two orders within the current order-date and acquisition filters. This is period purchase frequency, not a lifetime flag.

name: Repeat Purchasing Customer %
description: Customers with at least two selected-period orders divided by customers with any selected-period order.

name: Orders Per Paying Customer
description: Selected-period orders / distinct paying user IDs.

name: Revenue Per Paying Customer
description: Selected-period recorded order sales / paying user IDs.

name: Subsequent Purchase Orders
description: Orders whose user already placed a prior observed order in the complete extract. Classification is fixed at preparation, not reset by date slicers.

name: Subsequent Purchase Revenue
expression: CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], KEEPFILTERS('Fact_Orders'[Purchase Type] = "Subsequent purchase"))
description: Recorded sales from subsequent observed purchases, by order date. Left-censored before the extract begins.

name: Repeat Visitor Session Share
description: Source repeat-visitor sessions / all sessions; visitor recurrence is not buyer recurrence.

name: Cohort Customers
description: All observed first-purchase customers in the selected cohort. Cohort analysis ignores the report date slicer and retains its fixed original customer cohort.

name: Cohort Active Customers
expression:
// Hide cells without a complete observation month to avoid future zero retention.
VAR _age = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_CohortAge'[Month After First Purchase])
VAR _cohort = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Customer'[Purchase Cohort])
VAR _start = IF(_cohort <> "No observed purchase" && NOT ISBLANK(_cohort), DATE(VALUE(LEFT(_cohort,4)), VALUE(RIGHT(_cohort,2)), 1))
VAR _mature = NOT ISBLANK(_start) && EOMONTH(_start, _age) < DATE(2015,3,19)
RETURN IF(NOT ISBLANK(_age) && _mature, COALESCE(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNT('Fact_Orders'[Customer ID]), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Channel'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Device'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Visitor'), REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Landing'), 'Fact_Orders'[Purchase Age Month] = _age),0))
description: Distinct customers purchasing at selected months since first observed purchase. Calendar-month cohorts; date and acquisition slicers deliberately ignored to preserve the original customer cohort denominator. Incomplete/future cohort-month cells are blank.

name: Cohort Retention %
expression: IF(NOT ISBLANK([Cohort Active Customers]), DIVIDE([Cohort Active Customers], [Cohort Customers]))
description: Active customers / original first-purchase cohort size at selected month age. Month zero is the acquisition month. Blank until a full month is observed; no inference about churn.

name: MoM Revenue Growth
expression:
// Compare complete calendar months only; exclude partial edge months.
VAR _month = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Date'[Month Start])
VAR _priorMonth = EDATE(_month, -1)
VAR _ok = HASONEVALUE('Dim_Date'[Month Start]) && _month >= DATE(2012,4,1) && _month <= DATE(2015,2,1) && _priorMonth >= DATE(2012,4,1)
VAR _current = CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], _month, EOMONTH(_month,0)))
VAR _prior = CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], _priorMonth, EOMONTH(_priorMonth,0)))
RETURN IF(_ok, DIVIDE(_current - _prior, _prior))
description: Full-calendar-month revenue change against the preceding month. Requires one month and complete current/prior coverage; daily slice is expanded to full months. Partial extract boundary months are blank.

name: YoY Revenue Growth
expression:
// Compare complete calendar months only; exclude partial edge months.
VAR _month = SELECTEDVALUE('Dim_Date'[Month Start])
VAR _priorMonth = EDATE(_month, -12)
VAR _ok = HASONEVALUE('Dim_Date'[Month Start]) && _month >= DATE(2012,4,1) && _month <= DATE(2015,2,1) && _priorMonth >= DATE(2012,4,1)
VAR _current = CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], _month, EOMONTH(_month,0)))
VAR _prior = CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], _priorMonth, EOMONTH(_priorMonth,0)))
RETURN IF(_ok, DIVIDE(_current - _prior, _prior))
description: Full-calendar-month revenue change against the same month last year. Requires one month and complete current/prior coverage; daily slice is expanded to full months. Partial extract boundary months are blank.

name: Revenue Growth %
expression:
// Compare only contiguous windows of fully observed interior calendar days.
VAR _from = MIN('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR _to = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR _days = DATEDIFF(_from, _to, DAY) + 1
VAR _priorFrom = _from - _days
VAR _priorTo = _from - 1
VAR _contiguous = COUNTROWS(VALUES('Dim_Date'[Date])) = _days
VAR _valid = _contiguous && _from >= DATE(2012,3,20) && _to <= DATE(2015,3,18) && _priorFrom >= DATE(2012,3,20)
VAR _prior = CALCULATE([Gross Sales Revenue], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Date'), DATESBETWEEN('Dim_Date'[Date], _priorFrom, _priorTo))
RETURN IF(_valid, DIVIDE([Gross Sales Revenue] - _prior, _prior))
description: Change vs the same-length immediately preceding calendar-day window. Requires contiguous selected dates and fully observed interior days (2012-03-20 through 2015-03-18); source boundary days are partial. Separate from complete-month MoM/YoY.

name: Selected Period Label
expression:
VAR _min = MIN('Dim_Date'[Date])
VAR _max = MAX('Dim_Date'[Date])
RETURN FORMAT(_min, "dd MMM yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(_max, "dd MMM yyyy")
description: Dynamic selected calendar range. The underlying data coverage is separately disclosed.

name: Data Coverage Note
expression: "Sales/sessions: 19 Mar 2012–19 Mar 2015 | Refunds: through 01 Apr 2015 | USD"
description: Observed source bounds, not a claim of current data freshness.

name: Revenue Trend Title
description: Dynamic chart title showing the selected calendar range.

name: Conversion Chart Title
description: Dynamic conversion chart title with selected calendar dates.

name: Growth Color
expression: IF(ISBLANK([MoM Revenue Growth]), "#526074", IF([MoM Revenue Growth]>=0, "#087F80", "#A36512"))
description: Semantic formatting color for full-month MoM growth; blank comparison uses neutral text.

name: Refund Risk Color
expression: IF(ISBLANK([Product Refund Rate]), "#526074", IF([Product Refund Rate] > CALCULATE([Product Refund Rate], REMOVEFILTERS('Dim_Product')), "#A36512", "#087F80"))
description: Amber when product sale-cohort refund incidence exceeds the all-product incidence under the same remaining filters; descriptive comparison, not a risk threshold.

name: Executive Decision Note
expression: IF(ISBLANK([Gross Sales Revenue]), "No recorded sales in the selected context. Adjust the date or acquisition filters.", "Recorded sales are " & FORMAT([Gross Sales Revenue], "$#,##0") & " at " & FORMAT([Gross Margin %], "0.0%") & " gross margin before refunds and operating expenses. Selected sessions convert at " & FORMAT([Session-to-Order Conversion Rate], "0.0%") & ". Compare acquisition efficiency on the Marketing page and journey losses on Conversion.")
description: Filter-responsive executive narrative; reports observed values without inferring causes.
